+"""固定真实 a37 身份后准备单车输入；原五车输入和 B 权重只读。"""
+import os
+os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']=''
+from pathlib import Path
+import json, shutil
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+ROOT=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/drivingeditor_repro/campaign/scene008_a37_only_B10k_20261103_r1')

+    for name in ['calib','image','pose','sky','velodyne','annotations','timestamp','points3d.ply']:

+    # loader 会写 transform_matrix；使用独立副本，禁止经符号链接写旧现场。
+    shutil.copy2(OLD/'transform_matrix.txt',scene/'transform_matrix.txt')
+    shutil.copy2(OLD/'points3d_dynamic_4.ply',scene/'points3d_dynamic_0.ply')
+    asset=scene/'dynamic_actor_assets/actor_0';(asset/'body_masks').mkdir(parents=True)
+    shutil.copy2(OLD/'dynamic_actor_assets/actor_4/source_lidar_indices.npz',asset/'source_lidar_indices.npz')
+    for name in ['dynamic_image/dynamic_image_0','dynamic_masks/dynamic_mask_0','mask/mask_0/Annotations']:
+        (scene/name).mkdir(parents=True)
+    masks=[]
+    for row in prep['frames']:
+        fid=row['id'];p=OLD/'dynamic_actor_assets/actor_4/body_masks'/f'{fid}.png'
+        body=np.asarray(Image.open(p))>0
+        rgb=np.asarray(Image.open(scene/'image/image_0'/f'{fid}.png').convert('RGB'))
+        assert body.shape==rgb.shape[:2] and body.any()
+        dynamic=np.where(body[:,:,None],rgb,0).astype(np.uint8)
+        for sub in ['dynamic_masks/dynamic_mask_0','mask/mask_0/Annotations','dynamic_actor_assets/actor_0/body_masks']:
+            Image.fromarray(body.astype(np.uint8)*255).save(scene/sub/f'{fid}.png')
+        Image.fromarray(dynamic).save(scene/'dynamic_image/dynamic_image_0'/f'{fid}.png')
+        assert np.array_equal(np.asarray(Image.open(scene/'dynamic_masks/dynamic_mask_0'/f'{fid}.png'))>0,body)
+        assert np.array_equal(np.asarray(Image.open(scene/'dynamic_image/dynamic_image_0'/f'{fid}.png')),dynamic)
+        masks.append(dict(frame_id=fid,foreground_pixels=int(body.sum()),only_source_actor_index=4,alias=37))
+    for key in ['selected_real_track_ids','selected_genuine_raw_track_ids','selected_raw_track_ids']:
+        if key in prep:prep[key]=[TRACK]
+    prep['selected_real_track_ids']=[TRACK]
+    prep['identity_source']=dict(original_scene=str(OLD),source_actor_index=4,new_actor_index=0,alias=37,raw_track_id=TRACK)
+    write(scene/'preparation_manifest.json',prep)
+    actor=dict(actor,actor_index=0,source_actor_index=4,alias=37)
+    source.update(status='PASS_FIXED_SINGLE_A37_INPUT',scene=str(scene),actors=[actor],old_assets_modified=False,
+        actor_count=1,selection='only canonical existing actor_4; no posthoc checkpoint selection',dynamic_RGB_and_union_exact=True)
+    write(scene/'dynamic_multi_actor_preparation.json',source);write(scene/'dynamic_multi_actor_validation.json',source)
+    config=json.loads((PARENT/'effective_config.json').read_text())
+    original=json.loads(json.dumps(config))
+    config['source_path']=str(scene);config['model_path']=str(ROOT/'formal10k')
+    config['followup_scene_spec']['source_path']=str(scene)
+    config['followup_scene_spec']['actor_ply_paths']=[str(scene/'points3d_dynamic_0.ply')]
+    assert config['iterations']==30000 and config['start_checkpoint'] is None
+    write(ROOT/'config.json',config)
+    changes={k:dict(parent=original[k],single_actor=config[k]) for k in original if original[k]!=config[k]}
+    write(ROOT/'identity_contract.json',dict(task_id='SCENE008-A37-ONLY-B10K-20261103-R1',dynamic_actor_aliases=[37],
+        dynamic_raw_track_ids=[TRACK],source_actor_index=4,new_actor_index=0,retained_aliases=[5,26,18,6],
+        retained_representation='original B temporal static/background model; initialized and trained from scratch',
+        masks=masks,dynamic_ply_files=[str(scene/'points3d_dynamic_0.ply')],
+        source_ply_exact_bytes=(OLD/'points3d_dynamic_4.ply').read_bytes()==(scene/'points3d_dynamic_0.ply').read_bytes(),
+        source_real_point_count=actor['total_real_points'],canonical_identity_fixed_before_training=True,
+        warm_start=False,original_B_read_only=True,formal_updates=10000,learning_rate_horizon=30000,
+        config_changes=changes,smoke_accounting='separate from formal10k; same30k schedule; additional checkpoint/evaluation nodes',
+        inputs_role='49observedtrain BUILD; no heldout',no_subagents=True,shutdown_allowed=False,human_verdict=None,quality_accepted=False))

+"""原 B 原生训练入口；只在完整检查点发布后截止，不改学习率或损失。"""
+import os
+for k in ['OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']:os.environ[k]='1'
+from pathlib import Path
+import argparse, json, sys, time, gc
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+ENGINE=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/drivingeditor_repro/campaign/r15_baseline_owner5_20261018/training_source/scene0008_089_137')
+TOOLS=Path('/root/autodl-tmp/drivingeditor_repro/campaign/r15_gn11_stage1_v41_20261023/tools')
+
+class CompleteBoundary(Exception):pass
+
+def write(p,v):p.write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
+
+def main():
+    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--mode',choices=['smoke','resume','formal'],required=True)
+    ap.add_argument('--checkpoint',type=Path);ap.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
+    opts=ap.parse_args();out=opts.output;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
+    config=json.loads((ROOT/'config.json').read_text());config['model_path']=str(out)
+    if opts.mode=='smoke':
+        for key in ['checkpoint_iterations','save_iterations','test_iterations']:config[key]=list(range(1000,11000,1000))
+    if opts.mode=='resume':
+        config=json.loads((opts.checkpoint.parent/'effective_config.json').read_text())
+        config.update(model_path=str(out),start_checkpoint=str(opts.checkpoint))
+    write(out/'effective_config.json',config)
+    sys.path[:0]=[str(ENGINE),str(TOOLS)]
+    import torch, numpy as np
+    from omegaconf import OmegaConf
+    import train
+    from utils import paper_checkpoint as checkpoint
+    from utils import hybrid30k_runtime as runtime
+    from utils.general_utils import seed_everything
+    from run_v4_arm import bind_scene_contract
+    from compare_v1_states import differences
+    assert Path(train.__file__).resolve()==ENGINE/'train.py' and torch.cuda.is_available()
+    assert list(Path(config['source_path']).glob('points3d_dynamic_*.ply'))==[Path(config['source_path'])/'points3d_dynamic_0.ply']
+    bind_scene_contract(train,config)
+    bound_scene=train.Scene
+    def fixed_identity_scene(*args,**kwargs):
+        scene=bound_scene(*args,**kwargs)
+        identity=json.loads((ROOT/'identity_contract.json').read_text())
+        assert identity['dynamic_actor_aliases']==[37]
+        assert len(scene.dynamic_gaussians.get_xyz)==identity['source_real_point_count']==98452
+        write(out/'actual_identity_initialization.json',dict(status='PASS_SINGLE_A37_INITIALIZATION',dynamic_aliases=[37],
+            raw_track_id=identity['dynamic_raw_track_ids'][0],dynamic_rows_before_any_update=len(scene.dynamic_gaussians.get_xyz),
+            static_rows_before_any_update=len(scene.gaussians.get_xyz),dynamic_random_init_point=config['dynamic_random_init_point'],
+            actor_ply_paths=config['followup_scene_spec']['actor_ply_paths'],camera_count=len(scene.getTrainCameras())))
+        return scene
+    train.Scene=fixed_identity_scene
+    seed_everything(config['seed']);torch.set_num_threads(1)
+    original_publish=checkpoint.publish_checkpoint_event;original_restore=checkpoint.restore_training_state
+    original_record=runtime.record_step;started=time.monotonic();last=[0]
+    original_adam_step=torch.optim.Adam.step
+
+    def finite_adam_step(optimizer,*args,**kwargs):
+        if last[0]%100==0:
+            for group in optimizer.param_groups:
+                for parameter in group['params']:
+                    if parameter.grad is not None and not bool(torch.isfinite(parameter.grad).all()):
+                        raise RuntimeError('nonfinite backward gradient')
+        return original_adam_step(optimizer,*args,**kwargs)
+
+    def record(args,iteration,camera,time_shift,static,dynamic,losses):
+        original_record(args,iteration,camera,time_shift,static,dynamic,losses)
+        values={k:float(v) for k,v in losses.items()}
+        if not all(np.isfinite(v) for v in values.values()):raise RuntimeError('nonfinite loss')
+        last[0]=iteration
+        if iteration%100==0:
+            rec=dict(iteration=iteration,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,
+                allocated_bytes=torch.cuda.memory_allocated(),reserved_bytes=torch.cuda.memory_reserved(),
+                static_rows=len(static.get_xyz),dynamic_rows=len(dynamic.get_xyz),losses=values)
+            with (out/'runtime.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(rec,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
+            write(out/'progress.json',rec)
+        if opts.mode=='resume' and iteration>=int(opts.checkpoint.stem.replace('chkpnt',''))+3:
+            # record_step 位于反向前，前两步已完整更新；此步不计为更新。
+            write(out/'resume_entry.json',dict(status='PASS_NEXT_TRAINING_ENTRY',completed_extra_updates=2,entered_iteration=iteration))
+            raise CompleteBoundary()
+
+    def restore(path,iteration,scene,models,args,sgcm=None):
+        stack,ema=original_restore(path,iteration,scene,models,args,sgcm=sgcm)
+        saved=torch.load(path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
+        current=checkpoint.capture_training_state(iteration,scene,stack,models,args,sgcm=sgcm,ema=ema)
+        for item in [saved,current]:item['config']={k:v for k,v in item['config'].items() if k not in ['model_path','start_checkpoint']}
+        errors=differences(saved,current,'continuation')
+        for name,prefix in [('static','chkpnt'),('dynamic','dynamic_chkpnt'),('environment','env_light_chkpnt')]:
+            old,step=torch.load(Path(path).parent/f'{prefix}{iteration}.pth',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
+            errors+=differences(old,models[name].capture(),name);del old;gc.collect()
+        write(out/'restore_audit.json',dict(status='PASS_EXACT_FULL_RESTORE' if not errors else 'FAIL',iteration=iteration,differences=errors,
+            includes='parameters,Adam,Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG,camera sampler,SGCM,EMA,runtime',updates=0))
+        if errors:raise RuntimeError(str(errors))
+        return stack,ema
+
+    def publish(root,iteration,*args,**kwargs):
+        event=original_publish(root,iteration,*args,**kwargs)
+        write(out/'last_complete_node.json',dict(iteration=iteration,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,event=event['model_path']))
+        if (opts.mode=='smoke' and time.monotonic()-started>=540) or (opts.mode=='formal' and iteration==10000):
+            write(out/'returned.json',dict(status='PASS_COMPLETE_BOUNDARY',mode=opts.mode,iteration=iteration,
+                actual_updates=iteration,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,
+                learning_rate_horizon=30000,formal_stop=10000,max_allocated_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
+                max_reserved_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),quality_accepted=False,human_verdict=None))
+            raise CompleteBoundary()
+        return event
+
+    runtime.record_step=record;checkpoint.publish_checkpoint_event=publish;checkpoint.restore_training_state=restore
+    torch.optim.Adam.step=finite_adam_step
+    os.chdir(ENGINE)
+    try:train.training(OmegaConf.create(config))
+    except CompleteBoundary:pass
+    if opts.mode!='resume':assert (out/'returned.json').exists()
+    else:assert (out/'resume_entry.json').exists()
+    print(json.dumps(dict(status='TRAINING_ENTRY_RETURNED',mode=opts.mode,last_entered=last[0],elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-started)),flush=True)
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
